reason: The only proposal (D-53127d) is about naming server actions *Action, not unused variables; the code uses _-prefixed unused params (_request, _prevState, _error) and caught errors are generally used, though lint was not run.
No proposal concerns the any type; about 25 explicit any uses are concentrated in a handful of model files (backups, export_and_import, files, progress, apps) out of ~239 TS files.

No proposal concerns render purity; most components avoid impure calls but a few call Date.now()/Math.random()/new Date() during render (currency-converter, sidebar skeleton useMemo, date-range-picker).
No proposal concerns setState in effects; about 8 of the ~18 files using useEffect call setState synchronously in the effect body.
No proposal concerns immutability of props/state; grep found only mutation of locally created arrays/variables, no clear prop or state mutation, though the lint rule was not run.
